issues.title: [TEST] Example incident — no service outage
issues.body:
This is an authorized demonstration of Agio’s incident publication and resolution flow. No customer service is affected and no endpoint has been deliberately taken down.

We will publish an example update, verify the status snapshot, and resolve this test. The issue will remain as a clearly marked example in incident history.

1.body: Test update — investigating (simulation). We are validating incident updates on the independent Agio status page. There is no customer impact; all production services remain unchanged.

Resolved — test complete. The example incident and its update appeared in the published status snapshot. No customer outage occurred. This issue remains in incident history as a demonstration. Automatic failure detection and Slack delivery were not part of this test.
